chunks: And from him (Al-Shaykh) from Ibn Abi Umayr from Hammad from Al-Halabi from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
I asked him about a man who forgot to visit the House (Kaaba) until morning, so he said: 'Perhaps he delayed it until the days of Tashreeq pass, but he should not approach women and perfume.'
And it is recommended for whoever intends to visit the House to perform Ghusl (ritual bath) before entering the Mosque and performing Tawaf around the House. Narrated.

key_terms.أَيَّامُ التَّشْرِيقِ: The days of Tashreeq (11th, 12th, and 13th of Dhu al-Hijjah)

ai.seo_question: What is the recommended ritual purification before visiting the Kaaba if one delays until morning?
ai.summary: This narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies the flexibility of the Hajj visitation timeline, permitting delay until the days of Tashreeq while maintaining ritual purity by abstaining from intimacy and perfume. It further establishes the recommended etiquette (Mustahabb) of performing Ghusl prior to entering the Masjid al-Haram and circumambulating the Kaaba, reflecting the Shia emphasis on combining legal permissibility with spiritual refinement. This highlights the distinction between obligatory acts and recommended etiquettes in the jurisprudence of the Hajj.
